# omnid

> One small C++ server for local embeddings (nomic-embed-text v1.5 and BitNet-embedding-270M on llama.cpp), a hardened local web face and an MCP face. Models and the bitnet.cpp tree are not shipped.

Setup: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/SovRing-Labs/omnid && cd omnid && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && python -m pip install -q numpy pytest && BITNET_DIR=~/projects/bitnet ./build.sh && python3 -m pytest -q tests` (expect: 0 failed).
Status: pre-alpha, under development — read STATUS.md before relying on a number.
Licence: Apache-2.0.
